decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated several tiers of speakers, from high-end audiophile brands to budget waterproof models. The Bang & Olufsen Beosound A1 ($279) and JBL Charge 5 ($149.95) were the strongest contenders for quality. While the B&O offers a premium design, the JBL Charge 5 provides a better balance of price and durability, with nearly 17,000 reviews maintaining a 4.8-star average. It's waterproof, includes a power bank feature, and is widely regarded for its sound quality in this price bracket. The budget options like INSMY and DOSS are attractive for their price points, but for a primary speaker, the reliability and performance of the JBL make it the most compelling purchase.
